name: Indifference
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level adept 1, antipaladin 1, bard 1, inquisitor 1, lathspell 1, legendary ninja 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Targets one creature, and a target creature
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fill a target creature with feelings of indifference toward a secondary target creature. The target’s attitude is shifted to indifferent and cannot be shifted by Diplomacy and they are immune to spells like 25 charm person or spite of the same spell level or lower.

Additionally, the target cannot be treated as an ally or enemy for the purposes of spell or ability targeting and cannot provide flanking, teamwork feat benefits, or similar benefits to any other creature.

If the affected creature was hostile to the secondary target, they gain a +5 bonus on its saving throw. They will no longer be hostile on a failure but if attacked, will defend themselves and attack their attacker, though still feeling indifference while doing so.
